title: 不稳定时回滚权重
title_en: Roll Back Weights on an Unstable Epoch

standard.summary: 每个 epoch 边界留一份可训练权重的副本；某轮出现 clip 比例过高或权重范数暴涨时，把当前权重按 70/30 混回上一份稳定副本，并尽力恢复优化器状态。默认关闭。
standard.effect: 两个触发条件任一命中就回滚；回滚不是「撤销整轮」，而是 w ← stable×keep + current×(1-keep) 的插值。副本只在内存里，因此续训后的第一个 epoch 无法回滚。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练里偶发 loss 尖峰、又不想整天盯 loss 曲线时。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存已经很紧时——每轮一份 CPU 副本，超过 2GiB 的副本会被跳过并记录原因，等于白开。也不要在频繁续训的流程里指望它。

standard_en.summary: Keeps one copy of the trainable weights at each epoch boundary; when an epoch shows an excessive clip ratio or a runaway weight norm, current weights are blended 70/30 back toward the last stable copy, and the optimizer state is restored on a best-effort basis. Off by default.
standard_en.effect: Either trigger is enough. A rollback is not "undo the whole epoch" but the interpolation w <- stable x keep + current x (1 - keep). Snapshots live in memory only, so the first epoch after a resume cannot roll back.
standard_en.whenToUse: Long runs that occasionally spike and that you would rather not babysit.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When VRAM is already tight -- one CPU copy per epoch, and a copy over 2 GiB is skipped with a recorded reason, making the switch useless. Also do not rely on it in a workflow that resumes often.

advanced.principle: LrRollbackGuard 在 epoch 边界用快照待定（*_pending）的方式推进：本轮结束先比对 clip 比例与权重范数涨幅，再决定是否回滚，最后才把本轮状态提升为下一轮的基准——先拍后判会把不稳定本身混进基准里。前两轮不做判定（min_epochs 默认 2）。
advanced.intervention: 训练循环的 epoch 回调，优化器与模型结构都不变。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无训练速度影响，但每轮多一次可训练权重的 CPU 拷贝，占用主机内存。
advanced.tradeoffs: 优化器状态恢复是尽力而为：分页/量化优化器（如 turbo-core）不一定能往返 state_dict，失败时权重仍会回滚并把 optimizer_restored=False 写进事件日志，不要据此以为已完整复位。

advanced_en.principle: LrRollbackGuard advances by staging snapshots as pending: at an epoch boundary it first compares the clip ratio and weight-norm growth, decides whether to roll back, and only then promotes this epoch's state to the next baseline -- snapshotting before judging would blend the instability into the baseline. No decision is taken in the first two epochs (min_epochs defaults to 2).
advanced_en.intervention: An epoch callback in the training loop; neither the optimizer nor the model structure changes.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No effect on training speed, but one extra CPU copy of the trainable weights per epoch, which costs host memory.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Optimizer-state restore is best effort: paged / quantized optimizers (turbo-core) do not always round-trip state_dict; when the restore fails the weights are still rolled back and optimizer_restored=False goes into the event log, so do not read that as a full reset.
